summary: Adds mission-linked learning-note CRUD, stable identities, search, pagination and confirmed deletion.
Separates mission drafts from accepted progress; saves and review evidence are adopted only after browser storage succeeds.
Validates nested and legacy saves, catalog relationships and four-MiB UTF-8 bounds; preserves corrupt raw data and failed proposals for export.
Coordinates cooperating tabs with Web Locks, snapshot revisions and reset epochs; stale editors retain their fields.
Guards prerequisites, canonical checkpoint rewards and due review ratings; retries failed catalog/mission requests and bounds worker execution/output.
Adds nine detailed CRUD learning documents, real-browser tests, corrected setup/save guidance and reviewed desktop/narrow screenshots.
Verifies 36 model tests, 12 Chromium scenarios, production build and the unchanged 334-mission archive.

checks.command: npm test; npm run build; npm run verify:content; Playwright Chromium integration suite plus focused review/layout rerun
checks.environment: Node 22.16.0; React 19.2.8; TypeScript 7.0.2; Vite 8.2.2; Vitest 5.0.0; Playwright 1.60.0 / Chromium 148

limits: Local browser storage only; no authenticated backend, SQL database, cross-device synchronization or protected grading.
Whole-document revisions intentionally reject unrelated concurrent edits; Web Locks require localhost/HTTPS and cooperating clients.
Manual backups; damaged raw exports and oversized pending exports may need manual recovery before import.
Checkpoints are self-reported; worker execution is not a security sandbox or automated correctness grader.
No deployment, power-loss, uncooperative-writer or full accessibility certification.
